Seondo Electric.why: Makes gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), switchboards, vacuum circuit breakers and protection-relay panels for power plants, substations and industrial facilities; names SK Hynix and KEPCO as main customers, so grid and fab/data-center power build-outs drive its orders.
Seondo Electric.evidence: Seondo Electric Q2 FY2026 (09-30-2026) corrected half-year report, II. Business: power-conversion equipment segment makes switchboards, vacuum circuit breakers, gas-insulated switchgear and protection relays; main customers SK Hynix and Korea Electric Power Corporation.

players.product: gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), MV switchboards, vacuum circuit breakers and protection-relay panels

quarterly_data.signal: Corrected half-year report (filed 09-30-2026; the original was filed 08-13-2026 and the correction restates the statement of changes in equity): H1 2026 revenue KRW 8,069,222,048 (H1 2025: KRW 15,171,833,326) and an operating loss of KRW 1,521,912,121 (H1 2025: loss KRW 1,053,969,981); Q2 2026 revenue KRW 3,013,066,933 (Q2 2025: KRW 7,835,856,706), Q2 operating loss KRW 1,026,263,203. H1 product revenue: GIS KRW 3,953M (49.0%), switchboards KRW 2,196M (27.2%), relay panels KRW 1,732M (21.5%), other KRW 188M (2.3%); all sales domestic
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 8,069,222,048; operating loss KRW 1,521,912,121

quarterly_data.signal: Main customers of the power-conversion equipment segment (switchboards, vacuum circuit breakers, gas-insulated switchgear, protection relays) are SK Hynix and Korea Electric Power Corporation. Toshiba supplies digital and other relays (KRW 776M, 8.3% of H1 raw-material purchases) and licenses power-system protection-relay technology to the company under a technology-tie-up agreement
quarterly_data.counterparty: SK Hynix, Korea Electric Power Corporation (customers); Toshiba (supplier and licensor)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 production KRW 9,653M against a capacity of KRW 31,546M (switchboards 17,907, relay panels 3,203, GIS 9,644, other 792), average utilisation 31%

R&D: 7.2kV high-voltage switchboard (3-phase, 4,000A, 40kA, 60Hz, arc-resistant) testing, completed in April; 12kV switchboard (3-phase, 2,000A, 1250A) testing to complete July 2026; 72.5kV eco-friendly switchgear using dry air as the insulating medium in development, completion expected in 2026. Planned investment of KRW 1,500M in machinery over the next three fiscal years (KRW 500M a year) to raise capacity
quarterly_data.figure: 72.5kV dry-air switchgear due 2026; machinery capex KRW 1,500M
